description: This file is a shell script for extracting the uncompressed vmlinux from a kernel image, including functions for verification and decompression of various formats.

methods.name: check_vmlinux
methods.description: Verifies if the input file is a valid ELF or PE executable, and outputs the file content if valid.

methods.name: try_decompress
methods.description: Attempts to decompress the kernel image from various compression formats.
